passages.text: “Behold, I will send My messenger, who will prepare the way before Me. Then the Lord whom you seek will suddenly come to His temple—the Messenger of the covenant, in whom you delight—see, He is coming,” says the LORD of Hosts.
passages.sermon:
The LORD of Hosts speaks.
The LORD of Hosts is the God of Israel.
The LORD of Hosts says, “I will send My messenger.”
This messenger will prepare the way before Me.
You seek the Lord.
The Lord will suddenly come to His temple.
The Messenger of the covenant will come.
You delight in the Messenger of the covenant.
See, He is coming.
The LORD of Hosts has spoken.
passages.original: הִנְנִ֤י שֹׁלֵחַ֙ מַלְאָכִ֔י וּפִנָּה־ דֶ֖רֶךְ לְפָנָ֑י וּפִתְאֹם֩ יָב֨וֹא אֶל־ הֵיכָל֜וֹ הָאָד֣וֹן׀ אֲשֶׁר־ אַתֶּ֣ם מְבַקְשִׁ֗ים וּמַלְאַ֨ךְ הַבְּרִ֜ית אֲשֶׁר־ אַתֶּ֤ם חֲפֵצִים֙ הִנֵּה־ בָ֔א אָמַ֖ר יְהוָ֥ה צְבָאֽוֹת׃

passages.text: But who can endure the day of His coming? And who can stand when He appears? For He will be like a refiner’s fire, like a launderer’s soap.
passages.sermon:
The Lord of Hosts will come suddenly to His temple.
He is the Lord whom you seek.
He is the Messenger of the covenant in whom you delight.
Who can endure the day of His coming?
Who can stand when He appears?
He will be like a refiner’s fire.
He will be like a launderer’s soap.
passages.original: וּמִ֤י מְכַלְכֵּל֙ אֶת־ י֣וֹם בּוֹא֔וֹ וּמִ֥י הָעֹמֵ֖ד בְּהֵרָֽאוֹת֑וֹ כִּֽי־ הוּא֙ כְּאֵ֣שׁ מְצָרֵ֔ף וּכְבֹרִ֖ית מְכַבְּסִֽים׃

passages.text: And He will sit as a refiner and purifier of silver; He will purify the sons of Levi and refine them like gold and silver. Then they will present offerings to the LORD in righteousness.
passages.sermon:
The LORD of Hosts will come.
He will sit as a refiner.
He will act as a purifier of silver.
He will purify the sons of Levi.
He will make them clean.
He will refine them like gold.
He will refine them like silver.
The sons of Levi will become righteous.
They will bring offerings to the LORD.
They will present these offerings in righteousness.
passages.original: וְיָשַׁ֨ב מְצָרֵ֤ף וּמְטַהֵר֙ כֶּ֔סֶף וְטִהַ֤ר אֶת־ בְּנֵֽי־ לֵוִי֙ וְזִקַּ֣ק אֹתָ֔ם כַּזָּהָ֖ב וְכַכָּ֑סֶף וְהָיוּ֙ לַֽיהוָ֔ה מַגִּישֵׁ֥י מִנְחָ֖ה בִּצְדָקָֽה׃

passages.text: Then the offerings of Judah and Jerusalem will please the LORD, as in days of old and years gone by.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is God.
The LORD does not change.
Judah is a tribe of Israel.
Jerusalem is the holy city of Israel.
Judah and Jerusalem will bring offerings to the LORD.
These offerings will please the LORD.
The offerings will be like those in ancient days.
The offerings will be like those in former years.
passages.original: וְעָֽרְבָה֙ לַֽיהוָ֔ה מִנְחַ֥ת יְהוּדָ֖ה וִירֽוּשָׁלִָ֑ם כִּימֵ֣י עוֹלָ֔ם וּכְשָׁנִ֖ים קַדְמֹנִיּֽוֹת׃

passages.text: “Then I will draw near to you for judgment. And I will be a swift witness against sorcerers and adulterers and perjurers, against oppressors of the widowed and fatherless, and against those who defraud laborers of their wages and deny justice to the foreigner but do not fear Me,” says the LORD of Hosts.
passages.sermon:
The LORD of Hosts speaks.
He says, “I will come close to you for judgment.
I will act as a swift witness.
I will stand against sorcerers.
I will stand against adulterers.
I will stand against those who swear falsely.
I will stand against those who cheat workers of their wages.
I will stand against those who oppress widows.
I will stand against those who oppress orphans.
I will stand against those who turn aside the foreigner.
These people do not fear Me.
I, the LORD of Hosts, declare this.”
passages.original: וְקָרַבְתִּ֣י אֲלֵיכֶם֮ לַמִּשְׁפָּט֒ וְהָיִ֣יתִי׀ עֵ֣ד מְמַהֵ֗ר בַּֽמְכַשְּׁפִים֙ וּבַמְנָ֣אֲפִ֔ים וּבַנִּשְׁבָּעִ֖ים לַשָּׁ֑קֶר וּבְעֹשְׁקֵ֣י שְׂכַר־ שָׂ֠כִיר אַלְמָנָ֨ה וְיָת֤וֹם וּמַטֵּי־ גֵר֙ וְלֹ֣א יְרֵא֔וּנִי אָמַ֖ר יְהוָ֥ה צְבָאֽוֹת׃

passages.text: “Because I, the LORD, do not change, you descendants of Jacob have not been destroyed.
passages.sermon:
The LORD speaks.
The LORD does not change.
The descendants of Jacob still exist.
The LORD has not destroyed them.
passages.original: כִּ֛י אֲנִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה לֹ֣א שָׁנִ֑יתִי וְאַתֶּ֥ם בְּנֵֽי־ יַעֲקֹ֖ב לֹ֥א כְלִיתֶֽם׃

passages.text: Yet from the days of your fathers, you have turned away from My statutes and have not kept them. Return to Me, and I will return to you,” says the LORD of Hosts. “But you ask, ‘How can we return?’
passages.sermon:
The LORD of Hosts speaks.
He is the God of Israel.
He says this to the people of Israel.
From the days of your fathers, you have turned away from My statutes.
You have not kept My commands.
Return to Me.
I will return to you.
You ask, “How can we return?”
passages.original: לְמִימֵ֨י אֲבֹתֵיכֶ֜ם סַרְתֶּ֤ם מֵֽחֻקַּי֙ וְלֹ֣א שְׁמַרְתֶּ֔ם שׁ֤וּבוּ אֵלַי֙ וְאָשׁ֣וּבָה אֲלֵיכֶ֔ם אָמַ֖ר יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֑וֹת וַאֲמַרְתֶּ֖ם בַּמֶּ֥ה נָשֽׁוּב׃

passages.text: Will a man rob God? Yet you are robbing Me! But you ask, ‘How do we rob You?’ In tithes and offerings.
passages.sermon:
God is speaking.
God asks a question.
Can a man rob God?
God says, "You are robbing Me."
The people ask God a question.
They say, "How are we robbing You?"
God answers.
God says, "You rob Me in tithes and offerings."
passages.original: הֲיִקְבַּ֨ע אָדָ֜ם אֱלֹהִ֗ים כִּ֤י אַתֶּם֙ קֹבְעִ֣ים אֹתִ֔י וַאֲמַרְתֶּ֖ם בַּמֶּ֣ה קְבַעֲנ֑וּךָ הַֽמַּעֲשֵׂ֖ר וְהַתְּרוּמָֽה׃

passages.text: You are cursed with a curse, yet you—the whole nation—are still robbing Me.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to the people of Israel.
God says, “You are under a curse.
You are cursed because of your actions.
You are robbing Me.
The whole nation is robbing Me.”
passages.original: בַּמְּאֵרָה֙ אַתֶּ֣ם נֵֽאָרִ֔ים וְאֹתִ֖י אַתֶּ֣ם קֹבְעִ֑ים הַגּ֖וֹי כֻּלּֽוֹ׃

passages.text: Bring the full tithe into the storehouse, so that there may be food in My house. Test Me in this,” says the LORD of Hosts. “See if I will not open the windows of heaven and pour out for you blessing without measure.
passages.sermon:
The LORD of Hosts speaks.
He commands the people.
Bring the full tithe into the storehouse.
This will provide food in My house.
Test Me in this matter.
See if I, the LORD of Hosts, will not act.
I will open the windows of heaven for you.
I will pour out blessing for you.
The blessing will be more than enough.
passages.original: הָבִ֨יאוּ אֶת־ כָּל־ הַֽמַּעֲשֵׂ֜ר אֶל־ בֵּ֣ית הָאוֹצָ֗ר וִיהִ֥י טֶ֙רֶף֙ בְּבֵיתִ֔י וּבְחָנ֤וּנִי נָא֙ בָּזֹ֔את אָמַ֖ר יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֑וֹת אִם־ לֹ֧א אֶפְתַּ֣ח לָכֶ֗ם אֵ֚ת אֲרֻבּ֣וֹת הַשָּׁמַ֔יִם וַהֲרִיקֹתִ֥י לָכֶ֛ם בְּרָכָ֖ה עַד־ בְּלִי־ דָֽי׃

passages.text: I will rebuke the devourer for you, so that it will not destroy the fruits of your land, and the vine in your field will not fail to produce fruit,” says the LORD of Hosts.
passages.sermon:
The LORD of Hosts speaks.
The LORD of Hosts has great power.
The LORD of Hosts promises to act for you.
I will rebuke the devourer for you.
The devourer will not destroy the fruits of your land.
Your vine in the field will not fail to produce fruit.
The LORD of Hosts says this.
passages.original: וְגָעַרְתִּ֤י לָכֶם֙ בָּֽאֹכֵ֔ל וְלֹֽא־ יַשְׁחִ֥ת לָכֶ֖ם אֶת־ פְּרִ֣י הָאֲדָמָ֑ה וְלֹא־ תְשַׁכֵּ֨ל לָכֶ֤ם הַגֶּ֙פֶן֙ בַּשָּׂדֶ֔ה אָמַ֖ר יְהוָ֥ה צְבָאֽוֹת׃

passages.text: “Then all the nations will call you blessed, for you will be a land of delight,” says the LORD of Hosts.
passages.sermon:
The LORD of Hosts speaks.
He is the God who commands heaven’s armies.
He says this to His people.
All the nations will call you blessed.
You will be a land of delight.
passages.original: וְאִשְּׁר֥וּ אֶתְכֶ֖ם כָּל־ הַגּוֹיִ֑ם כִּֽי־ תִהְי֤וּ אַתֶּם֙ אֶ֣רֶץ חֵ֔פֶץ אָמַ֖ר יְהוָ֥ה צְבָאֽוֹת׃ס

passages.text: “Your words against Me have been harsh,” says the LORD. “Yet you ask, ‘What have we spoken against You?’
passages.sermon: The LORD of Hosts speaks.\r\nThe LORD says, “Your words against Me have been harsh.”\r\nYou ask the LORD, “What have we spoken against You?”
passages.original: חָזְק֥וּ עָלַ֛י דִּבְרֵיכֶ֖ם אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֑ה וַאֲמַרְתֶּ֕ם מַה־ נִּדְבַּ֖רְנוּ עָלֶֽיךָ׃

passages.text: You have said, ‘It is futile to serve God. What have we gained by keeping His requirements and walking mournfully before the LORD of Hosts?
passages.sermon:
The people of Israel spoke about God.
They said, "It is useless to serve God."
They asked, "What benefit do we get from obeying God's commands?"
They also asked, "What do we gain by walking in sorrow before the LORD of Hosts?"
passages.original: אֲמַרְתֶּ֕ם שָׁ֖וְא עֲבֹ֣ד אֱלֹהִ֑ים וּמַה־ בֶּ֗צַע כִּ֤י שָׁמַ֙רְנוּ֙ מִשְׁמַרְתּ֔וֹ וְכִ֤י הָלַ֙כְנוּ֙ קְדֹ֣רַנִּ֔ית מִפְּנֵ֖י יְהוָ֥ה צְבָאֽוֹת׃

passages.text: So now we call the arrogant blessed. Not only do evildoers prosper, they even test God and escape.’ ”
passages.sermon:
The people spoke about the arrogant.
They called the arrogant blessed.
They saw that evildoers prosper.
Evildoers test God.
Evildoers escape punishment.
passages.original: וְעַתָּ֕ה אֲנַ֖חְנוּ מְאַשְּׁרִ֣ים זֵדִ֑ים גַּם־ נִבְנוּ֙ עֹשֵׂ֣י רִשְׁעָ֔ה גַּ֧ם בָּחֲנ֛וּ אֱלֹהִ֖ים וַיִּמָּלֵֽטוּ׃

passages.text: At that time those who feared the LORD spoke with one another, and the LORD listened and heard them. So a scroll of remembrance was written before Him regarding those who feared the LORD and honored His name.
passages.sermon:
Those who feared the LORD spoke to each other.
The LORD listened to them.
The LORD heard what they said.
A scroll of remembrance was written before the LORD.
This scroll recorded those who feared the LORD.
This scroll recorded those who honored the LORD’s name.
passages.original: אָ֧ז נִדְבְּר֛וּ יִרְאֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה אִ֣ישׁ אֶת־ רֵעֵ֑הוּ וַיַּקְשֵׁ֤ב יְהוָה֙ וַיִּשְׁמָ֔ע וַ֠יִּכָּתֵב סֵ֣פֶר זִכָּר֤וֹן לְפָנָיו֙ לְיִרְאֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה וּלְחֹשְׁבֵ֖י שְׁמֽוֹ׃

passages.text: “They will be Mine,” says the LORD of Hosts, “on the day when I prepare My treasured possession. And I will spare them as a man spares his own son who serves him.
passages.sermon:
The LORD of Hosts speaks.
The LORD of Hosts has great power and authority.
The LORD of Hosts says, “They will belong to Me.
I will claim them on the day I prepare My treasured possession.
I will show them mercy.
I will spare them.
A man spares his own son who serves him.
In the same way, I will spare those who are Mine.”
passages.original: וְהָ֣יוּ לִ֗י אָמַר֙ יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת לַיּ֕וֹם אֲשֶׁ֥ר אֲנִ֖י עֹשֶׂ֣ה סְגֻלָּ֑ה וְחָמַלְתִּ֣י עֲלֵיהֶ֔ם כַּֽאֲשֶׁר֙ יַחְמֹ֣ל אִ֔ישׁ עַל־ בְּנ֖וֹ הָעֹבֵ֥ד אֹתֽוֹ׃

passages.text: So you will again distinguish between the righteous and the wicked, between those who serve God and those who do not.”
passages.sermon:
God will act on a coming day.
On that day, you will see a clear difference.
You will see the difference between the righteous and the wicked.
You will see the difference between those who serve God and those who do not serve Him.
passages.original: וְשַׁבְתֶּם֙ וּרְאִיתֶ֔ם בֵּ֥ין צַדִּ֖יק לְרָשָׁ֑ע בֵּ֚ין עֹבֵ֣ד אֱלֹהִ֔ים לַאֲשֶׁ֖ר לֹ֥א עֲבָדֽוֹ׃ס
